POSE 1 (Top Left): ISSUE. Leaning back excessively; center of gravity is behind the base of support, creating instability.
POSE 2 (Top Center): ISSUE. Standing on one leg with the other leg crossed in front creates a very narrow, unstable base of support; high risk of falling.
POSE 3 (Top Right): OK. Balanced standing pose with a wide, stable stance and appropriate weight distribution.
POSE 4 (Bottom Left): ISSUE. Standing on one leg while lifting the other high results in poor balance and an unstable foundation.
POSE 5 (Bottom Center): OK. Kneeling pose with a stable base of support and neutral spine alignment.
POSE 6 (Bottom Right): OK. Stable kneeling position with proper weight distribution on the lower legs.
